items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 November 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 22 November 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds until later.


##Synopsis##

Stationary front lies over the south of Ireland and southwest Britain, with high pressure centred in the Norwegian Sea.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 6 or 7, gradually decreasing Southeast 5 or 6 this afternoon, then Southeast 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate this afternoon, slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in west of area tomorrow morning, then generally 5 or 6 in afternoon. Further increasing Southeast 6 to gale 8 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.
